greeting: Hi! Thanks for messaging. We help you apply for a credit card for free.

consent.prompt: Before we start: we will collect your details only for your credit card application (Data Privacy Act of 2012). Do you agree? (Yes / No)
consent.decline_reply: No problem. Message us anytime if you change your mind.

carded.prompt: Do you have a credit card now? (Yes / No)
carded.reject_reply: Thank you! Sorry, we have no offer right now for people without a credit card. You can try again after 6 months.

banks.prompt: Which banks are your credit cards from? (e.g. BDO, BPI, Metrobank, RCBC, EastWest)
banks.unknown_reply: Please type the bank names of your credit cards (e.g. BDO, BPI, Metrobank).
banks.excluded_reply: Thank you, and congrats on all your credit cards!

steps.prompt: What is your full name? (First, Middle, Last)

steps.invalid_reply: That does not look like a PH mobile number (e.g. 0917 123 4567).

id_photo.prompt: Last step: please send a clear photo of one valid government ID.
id_photo.need_image_reply: Please send the ID as a photo.

done_reply: Thank you! Your application details are complete. We will update you here.
